brief:
Lubna Speitan, a UK Green Party member with Palestinian roots, has received death threats via messages and emails following her involvement in an anti-Zionism motion, Al Jazeera English reported. Speitan believes the threats are intended to intimidate her and suppress her political advocacy.

The threats come as the Green Party debates positions critical of Zionism, with Speitan now facing security concerns tied to her parliamentary activity.
dek: Lubna Speitan, who has Palestinian roots, believes messages and emails are part of an effort to intimidate her.
title: UK Green Party member receives death threats over anti-Zionism motion
